validation_status: Not executed. Cases for the parent's single integrated RC3 validation, not a separate harness.
access: In a PORTABLE build, use a Repel from the bag in eligible solo field play and walk until the existing VAR_REPEL_STEP_COUNT expires. One owned strength prompts yes/no; multiple strengths show owned items plus Cancel. No launcher setting.

provenance.credit: Native repeat-Repel adapted from RHH's pokeemerald-expansion, based on pret/pokeemerald. Contributor credits remain upstream; no individual module authorship is inferred.
provenance.rights: Attribution is not a blanket license or asset redistribution grant. No new graphics/audio assets imported.

cases.setup: Expire with no owned Repel, Super Repel or Max Repel.
cases.expect: Original expiry message only; no selection, inventory change or counter restart. Field input resumes.

cases.setup: Repeat separately with only Repel (86), only Super Repel (83), only Max Repel (84) owned.
cases.expect: Prompt names the owned item. Exactly one is removed, existing counter restarts at 100/200/250 respectively, success sound/message name the consumed item. Normal steps decrement it.

cases.setup: One owned strength remains at expiry.
cases.expect: Neither path consumes or restarts. No success message/sound. Field control restored.

cases.setup: Repeat with each two-strength subset and all three strengths owned, with neighboring native item IDs also owned.
cases.action: Choose each offered strength in separate runs.
cases.expect: Only owned Repels appear, ordered Repel/Super/Max, plus Cancel. Correct selected identity is consumed once and its stock duration is set. Neighboring non-Repels never appear.

cases.setup: Two or three strengths owned at expiry.
cases.action: Repeat with B and explicit Cancel.
cases.expect: No inventory/counter mutation or success feedback. Menu window/task removed and normal field input returns.

cases.setup: Exercise refusal before entry and after prompt using controlled integrated RC fixtures, never live human saves.
cases.expect: No choice offered in ineligible entry contexts. If eligibility changes during an offer, accept refuses without consumption or counter write. Native Pike/Pyramid/Union expiry exclusions remain unchanged.

cases.setup: After a valid offer, separately remove the selected last item, replace counter with nonzero, change save/map identity, submit out-of-range or B result, and force RemoveBagItem refusal in the integrated fixture.
cases.expect: Every case refuses without counter write or additional consumption; no success feedback. Selection refers to the offered identity, not reordered current bag slots. A second commit cannot consume again.

cases.setup: Exercise the real expiry script, then attempt direct Begin/Draw/Commit calls and calls from an unrelated script continuation.
cases.expect: Real expiry can prompt and commit despite its enabled script/field lock. Unrelated/direct calls fail exact continuation checks. Cancel clears transient authorization.

cases.setup: Multiple strengths owned; exhaust tasks/windows or hold another choice task in a controlled integrated fixture before drawing.
cases.expect: No invalid task/window access or stranded waitstate. Refusal closes the expiry flow without consuming.

cases.setup: Use disposable integrated RC saves. Save/reload while a Repel remains active, and compare the stock non-PORTABLE branch in the parent's existing baseline checks.
cases.expect: Existing bag/counter save semantics remain. No SaveBlock growth, last-item var or sidecar. No guarantee of remembered strength. Stock GBA script and menu path remain selected without PORTABLE. No claim of compiled ROM neutrality until parent verification.
